review: GLM Set A real rerun anti-cheat and usefulness review
required_fixes_before_set_b: Make the grader adversarial on usefulness, not keyword/template presence: require at least one 'How it changed the plan' bullet to describe a decision that differs from the no-research default, and reject work products with corrupted/non-ASCII tokens (e.g. 'لمs') or fabricated hosts (e.g. 'vlvm', 'dexevelopeer.*').

Re-fix A5: run a Mac worker job that returns real workstation evidence (GPU/unified-memory model fit or an actual model load/throughput probe) and use it to decide Dell-vs-Mac-vs-Windows roles, or mark A5 BLOCKED_ENV. A 'python3 --version' capability ping must not satisfy a Mac-required three-machine cost plan. Report mac_system_status_alone_used_as_pass truthfully.

Re-fix A2: require the plan to state the specific MV3/native-messaging constraints surfaced by research (nativeMessaging manifest permission, native-host registration, message-size cap, service-worker lifecycle), not just name the pattern; reject corrupted-domain echo.

Re-run A5 and A9 (garbled/under-specified) under the tightened grader until they produce clean goal-shaped output or are honestly downgraded to NEEDS_FIX/BLOCKED_ENV; do not regress usefulness average below the prior draft's 3.9 (current 3.4).

Keep unchanged: prompt integrity (byte-identical to battery-v4.1), live harness path, live research provider invocation, real same-trace consumer plumbing, no-mutation safety, no Set B/C/Plan 4, and lane selection logic.
notes: Real improvement over the old failed generator: _stage4r_runner.py is orchestration glue that imports real Source Proxy modules (run_current_research_for_task, run_mac_worker_for_task, decide_route, create_plan3_durable_task, record_subsystem_integration_result, apply_plan3_policy), calls a live Ollama model (gemma3n:e4b) per attempt, writes raw evidence per step, derives final_status from grade(), and computes fake_go_detected. Old canned PLANS/SOURCES, stamped PASS, hardcoded fake_go, and static repo block are gone.
Prompt integrity fully PASS: all 10 A1-A10 user_prompts byte-identical to battery-v4.1; no tailoring, no leaked expectations, A2/A5 not rewritten.

Research provider is genuinely live: readiness probe shows SearXNG returning 13 real PKHeX titles; all 7 research prompts carry real, specific, mostly 2026-dated source lists. A1/A3/A4/A6 are genuinely evidence-shaped and useful (scores 4/4/5/5).

Research materiality grading is echo-driven: research_materially_changed_output is satisfied by emitting the prompt-mandated 'Finding:/Source:/How it changed the plan:' template plus >=2 source-domain/title echoes. Reproduced locally: a 3-sentence title+domain echo scores source_hit_count=8 (needs >=2). usefulness/limitations/handoff gates are bare keyword presence.

A2 passed with hallucinated/corrupted domains (dexevelopeer.chrome.com, dexevelopeer.mozilla.org); A9 passed with garbled non-ASCII tokens (local_l لمs, l لم-inference) and a fabricated host (vlvm). A keyword grader cannot catch these.

A5 not fixed in substance: Mac validation is 'python3 --version' via mode mac_safe_check -> job_type run_safe_check, which passes the mac_job_type != 'system_status' gate but is the same trivial capability ping the prior review rejected (cheat #14/#15). mac_system_status_alone_used_as_pass is therefore misreported as false.

A5 also dodges the actual user goal: collapses Dell/Mac/Windows into one machine, gives no per-box cost/GPU guidance, ignores the homelab-GPU/Docker research, and overclaims Mac fitness on the basis of the version ping.

Usefulness average 3.4 (A1=4,A2=3,A3=4,A4=5,A5=2,A6=5,A7=3,A8=3,A9=2,A10=3) - below the 4.0 bar; A5 and A9 at the floor (2); A2(3) and A5(2) below the required 4 for previously-failing prompts. Average is lower than the prior failed draft's 3.9.

Trace/consumer plumbing is real and fresh (new task_id/trace_id/consumer_event_id per prompt, same-trace by construction, not copied from old set-a), but raw evidence at /home/source/spiritos-evidence/plan-03-3x10-dryrun/set-a-rerun/ is unreachable on this win32 review seat, so same-trace and consumer claims could not be byte-verified. downstream_consumed=true proves an event was recorded, not that the consumed work is genuinely useful.

Safety clean: no media/Jellyfin/SpiritFlix mutation (A6 policy gate is a recording, not a filesystem mutation), no Set B/C, no Plan 4, no staging/commit/push, 0 staged files, 0 dirty source_proxy or set-a-rerun files. Pre-existing unrelated SpiritFlix/handoff/media tree dirt was present and ignored.

Verdict NEEDS_FIX, not ACCEPT: the structural prior cheats are fixed, but a non-adversarial grader plus A5's renamed Mac ping still produce an unearned 10/10 GO. Do not approve Stage 5 Set B on this rerun.
